name: Ger (Spain)
description: Dark green field with the white dove of the arms facing the hoist in the upper hoist and a white wavy stripe along the lower part.
history: The flag incorporates the heraldic symbols (arms approved 24 January 1989); it was approved on 21 November 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 22 January 2003: an oblong flag of 2:3, dark green, with the white dove of the arms facing the hoist, 4/9 of the height, at 1/18 from the upper edge.

features.role: dove of the arms facing the hoist, 4/9 of the height
